ns2:section.sectionText: REGISTRATION IN THIS LAB SECTION REQUIRES SIMULTANEOUS REGISTRATION IN LECTURE SECTION AL1, CRN 61602. Please note the stated prerequisites. If available, seats may open to sophomore majors on Dec 8. Watch the class schedule for updated information. Please note: This section will offer a mix of synchronous (live) and asynchronous (not live) sessions. Your instructor will be in contact with further details including information on course management systems.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Junior, Senior, or Sophomore class standing.
